claims.passage: ent with TGF-b can induce EMT in A549 cells.28,29 However, to our knowledge, it is not known if this growth factor induction of EMT in A549 cells can be regulated by changes in substrate stiffness. To investigate if substrate stiffness alters TGF-b induced EMT, A549 cells were cultured on the different PDMS substrates and exposed to 5 ng/mL TGF-b for 48 h. Western blots were used to evaluate changes in E-cadherin and N-cadherin pro- tein expression. As shown in Figure 5(a–c), TGF-b treatment resulted in a consistent, and statistically signiﬁcant, decrease in E-cadherin and a consistent increase in N-cadherin for all conditions investigated. To investigate if cells cultured on different substrate stiffness exhibit different degrees of EMT during TGF-b treatment, we also evaluated the relative fold decrease in E-cadherin and fold increase in N-cadherin as a function of substrate stiffness.
